'''Matthew Cenci''' (also published as '''Mathew Cenci''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Arizona State Championship]] on 14 April 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2082">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He also played at the [[February 2001 Mesa tournament]] on 24 February 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM Capture Deck]], according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-game], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
